sources.title: amd/AMD-OLMo · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: AMD-OLMo-1B: Pre-trained on a subset of Dolma v1.7 that consists of 1.3 trillion tokens. AMD-OLMo-1B-SFT: Supervised fine-tuned (SFT) on Tulu V2 dataset (1st phase) and then OpenHermes-2.5, WebInstructSub, and Code-Feedback datasets (2nd phase). AMD-OLMo-1B-SFT-DPO: Aligned with human preferences using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) on UltraFeedback dataset.

sources.title: AMD-OLMo-1B - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: AMD-OLMo AMD-OLMo are a series of 1B language models trained from scratch by AMD on AMD Instinct™ MI250 GPUs. The training code used is based on OLMo. We release the pre-trained model, supervised fine-tuned model, and DPO aligned model as follows: AMD-OLMo-1B: Pre-trained on a subset of Dolma v1.7 that consists of 1.3 trillion tokens.
